authorization: Root native E2104/H1 assignment; one exact canonical source-build command, no source or Git publication changes.

bazelIdentityPreflight.fileIdentity: ELF 64-bit LSB executable; executable mode; inspected read-only

wrapperFlowObservedFromSource: Resolve checkpoint root and change directory there.

Run ci/bazel/bootstrap.py; it validates Node against .nvmrc, copies/hash-records declared host tools, installs exact locked npm dependencies only if toolchain inputs are missing/stale, and writes the private build-tools toolchain record.
Select BAZEL from the explicitly supplied absolute path, read .bazelversion, and require exact version equality.
Run the build-helper Node test file.
Run Bazel in batch mode for //:site with the wrapper's configured output-user-root.
Run ci/bazel/verify-output.mjs against bazel-bin/site.site and bazel-bin/site.receipt.json.

measurementPredictionOnly.interpretation: Predictions only; actual named summary from the fresh receipt/log is authoritative. The HH count overlaps full npm and must not be summed into an independent total.

stopPolicy: Execute the canonical command once. Preserve first unexpected failure, raw output, exit and signal; no retry, cache reenactment, source change, assertion weakening, environment override, extra Bazel flag, or publication action.
